name: LM Evaluation Harness
summary: EleutherAI's widely used framework for few-shot evaluation of language models across hundreds of benchmarks, with HF, vLLM and API backends.
description: Install with `pip install lm-eval`; run tasks with `lm_eval --model hf --model_args pretrained=... --tasks ...`. PyPI `lm-eval` 0.4.13 (2026-08-31), Python >=3.10.
